tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// sems 'dul tshul gyi nyams dbyangs bzhugs// ༄༅// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// mngon shes mig bral bdag ni las mang zhing*// ma drangs skye bo'i gcong rong tsher nang du// byang chub sems kyi mkhar shing lcug ldem pas// khro bcas g.yang sa'i nang du lhung du dogs// sems kyi glang po tshul khrims kyi lcags kyu can// dran dang shes bzhin rgyan gyis legs brgyan nas// byang chub sems kyi bka' chen ma brtan na// nga rgyal myos chus las la bshes kyis dogs// yid kyis cang shes thos bsam rgyan can 'di// bsgom sems brtson pa'i lcag gis ma bskul na// mnga' ris yul gyi ljang bus sems drangs nas// kun mkhyen rgyal po'i gnas su ma phyin dogs// sems kyi ded dpon rgyud don gru gzings can// ting 'dzin brtson pa'i ba dan gyis brgyan kyang*// gdams ngag zab mo'i rig sngags bsten byas la// ting 'dzin skyon can klong du 'gro mi bya// dpal ldan sa skya'i gnas su gsungs/// / ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
